ENA reports the Ministry of Urban and Infrastructure signed a $30 million contract with Korea's Wavus JV on 9 January 2024 to build a land information management system in Bahir Dar, Adama, Hawassa and Sodo.
AMECO reports that Ethiopia's urban ministry and INSA signed an agreement to combine legal, physical and cadastral data in one unified digital land system and to expand e-Land digital services.

Finland's Ministry for Foreign Affairs says more than 5 million formal land transactions, including inheritances, gifts, exchanges and consolidations, had been recorded in Ethiopia's digital land registry by the end of June 2026.
The Ethiopian News Agency reports the National Rural Land Administration Information System (NRLAIS) has been operational in 450 woredas and has certified some 30 million land parcels.
